**Question:** What is the temperature in Celsius if the temperature of a healthy body is $98.4^\circ\text{F}$?

**Answer:** The relation between Celsius and Fahrenheit temperature is
$$T_C = \frac{5}{9}(T_F - 32^\circ)$$

If $T_F = 98.4^\circ$, we get
$$T_C = \frac{5}{9}(98.4^\circ - 32^\circ) = 36.89^\circ$$
(i.e., it is nearly equal to $37^\circ\text{C}$)

**Question:** At which temperature the readings in Celsius and Kelvin scale are equal?
